pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Lava Eater Lair.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The enabled setting blocks arrows. Fire contact, burning, lava and fall damage are rejected as well; sleep protects against normal hits. Fire Resistance helps you with the surroundings, but setting the boss on fire does not replace melee combat.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. The enabled setting blocks arrows. Fire Resistance helps you with the surroundings, but setting the boss on fire does not replace melee combat. This profile does not use hosted preparation. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Lava Eater's Skin. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
